feeds.title: Falls Creek
feeds.description: Falls Creek is Victoria's largest alpine resort and a major tourist destination in North East Victoria. The alpine resort is one of the most popular winter playgrounds in the country and offers a superb range of activities, attractions and events in every season throughout the year With ski-in/ski-out accommodation, skiing and snowboarding for all abilities and a huge range of daytime and night-time activities.

feeds.title: B'Rush Ski Club News
feeds.description: Brush Ski Club is a not for profit people orientated club with a shared passion for snow sports that exists to provide a fun and environmentally friendly mountain experience for members, families and guests. This blog is designed by skiers for skiers, offering all the best in a skiing holiday.

feeds.title: Snowcentral News
feeds.description: Snow central has Ski Gear, Snowboard Gear, Snow Accessories & Ski Equipment for all of your winter adventures. Here you will find review of the latest season's ski and snowboard gear. Whether you're in the market for a new board, or wondering how to pick your goggles, they've got a clip to help and make your decision a little easier!

feeds.title: Blackbird Bespoke Ski Co News
feeds.description: Find Australia's best range of all mountain, resort, backcountry and freeride skis under one roof. Here you will get ski educational information and ski equipment products to enhance ski performance.

feeds.title: Aussie Skier Blog
feeds.description: Aussie Skier blog documents their skiing adventures through trip reports. It evolved to include gear reviews and provide real reports of the resort conditions.

feeds.title: Snow Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Snow Fitness is aimed specifically at skiers and snowboards who want to prepare their bodies to ski or board harder, longer and recover quicker. Subscribe to stay up-to-date with the latest news from Snow Fitness and also to keep up with their online snowboard & ski exercise programs.

feeds.title: Thredbo Ski Racing Club News
feeds.description: The Thredbo Ski Racing Club has been a top provider of alpine ski race training in Australia for the past 3 decades. The TSRC helps facilitates the development of many ski racers, from young eager competent skiers, to the highest level racers.

feeds.title: Roller Ski Downunder Blog
feeds.description: Everything Nordic sports in one Blog. Here you find lots of information about the Roller ski,Cross skating an Nordic walking community in Australia. Tips and trick for ski & skate maintenance, travel info and lots more.
